title: Crittenden Wines, King's Birthday Wine Weekend Events
summary: Crittenden's King's Birthday weekend across cellar door, restaurant and Lakeside Villas: seated tastings of 25+ wines, new restaurant, and a Flinders Truffles two-night package option.
priceRange: AUD 30+ for tastings; restaurant from approx AUD 80–120pp
accessibilityNotes: Award-winning Wine Centre accessible; restaurant ground floor; Lakeside Villas, check with venue
weatherDependency: Outdoor alfresco gardens; indoor cellar door available
nearbyAttractions: Pt Leo Estate (nearby); Bass & Flinders Distillery; Peninsula Hot Springs
suggestedItineraryPairing: Arrive for cellar door tasting; stay at Lakeside Villas; dine in restaurant; include hot springs next morning
editorVerdict: If you take wine seriously, this is the King's Birthday booking to make. Seated tastings of 25+ pours, the new restaurant, and the option to not drive home.
editorNote:
Crittenden treats King's Birthday weekend as a proper open-house: seated tastings across 25+ wine styles, the new restaurant (opened October 2025) running full service, and the Lakeside Villas available if you want to make a night of it.

This isn't a walk-in punt. Book the tasting before the weekend, and book the restaurant earlier than you think you need to. The truffle escape package with Flinders Truffles (two nights plus a hunt) is the upgrade move for couples who want one weekend to remember.

Pair Sunday with Pt Leo Estate or finish Monday morning at Peninsula Hot Springs. Crittenden is also pouring at the Winter Wine Festival at Red Hill Showgrounds on Saturday if you want to sample more producers first.
